name: countByStep
signature: public static long countByStep(int start, int end, int step)
description: Counts the values in the inclusive sequence from start toward end, advancing by the positive step; end is counted only if the sequence reaches it. Returns 0 when step is not positive, and returns 1 when start equals end and step is positive.
code_b: public static long countByStep(int start, int end, int step) { if (step <= 0 || start > end) { return 0; } long difference = (long) end - start; return difference / step + 1; }

code_b: public static int countTargetCharactersAfterLastHash(String text, char target) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int lastHash = text.lastIndexOf('#'); if (lastHash == -1) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = text.length() - 1; i > lastHash; i--) { if (text.charAt(i) == target) { count++; } } return count; }

code_b: public static String multiplicationTable(int n) { if (n <= 0) { return ""; } StringBuilder table = new StringBuilder(); for (long row = 1; row <= n; row++) { if (row > 1) { table.append('\n'); } for (long column = 1; column <= n; column++) { if (column > 1) { table.append(" | "); } table.append(row * column); } } return table.toString(); }

code_b: public static int gcdNonnegative(int first, int second) { if (first < 0 || second < 0) { return -1; } while (second != 0) { int remainder = first % second; first = second; second = remainder; } return first; }

name: uniqueWordsLowercase
description: Returns the first occurrence of each non-empty word, in the original order, joined by single spaces; words are stripped and compared in lowercase using Locale.ROOT. Returns an empty string for a null or empty array, and ignores null or blank items.
code_b: public static String uniqueWordsLowercase(String[] words) { if (words == null || words.length == 0) { return ""; } String[] seen = new String[words.length]; int seenCount = 0; StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(); for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] != null) { String clean = words[i].strip(); if (!clean.isEmpty()) { String key = clean.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT); boolean found = false; for (int j = 0; j < seenCount; j++) { if (seen[j].equals(key)) { found = true; break; } } if (!found) { seen[seenCount] = key; seenCount++; if (result.length() > 0) { result.append(' '); } result.append(clean); } } } } return result.toString(); }

code_b: public static int firstTrueIndex(boolean[] flags) { if (flags == null || flags.length == 0) { return -1; } int low = 0; int high = flags.length - 1; int answer = -1; while (low <= high) { int middle = low + (high - low) / 2; if (flags[middle]) { answer = middle; high = middle - 1; } else { low = middle + 1; } } return answer; }
